```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
```

#Read in and collate all the files in the DOC Processed Data folder 
```{r}

files <- list.files(path = "../../FATE Monitoring/DOC_data/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  # avoids factors
  # df$Site <- as.character(df$Site)             # ensures character
  return(df)
})

# Combine all files
DOC_data <- bind_rows(data_list)

#remove the first unneeded column
DOC_data <- DOC_data[, -which(names(DOC_data) == "X")]
colnames(DOC_data)

DOC_data1 <- DOC_data %>% 
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date)) %>% 
  select(Project, Date, Time, Sample_Location, npoc_mgL, npoc_uM, npoc_flag, tdn_mgL, tdn_uM, tdn_flag)

```

#Read in and collate all the files in the DIC Processed Data folder
```{r}

files <- list.files(path = "../../FATE Monitoring/DIC_data/Processed Data", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  # avoids factors
  # df$Site <- as.character(df$Site)             # ensures character
  return(df)
})

# Combine all files
DIC_data <- bind_rows(data_list)

#remove the first unneeded column
DIC_data <- DIC_data[, -which(names(DIC_data) == "X")]

DIC_data1 <- DIC_data %>% 
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date)) %>% 
  group_by(Project, Date, Time, Sample_Location) %>% ##Average and sd across replicates
  summarise( 
    ic_mgL_sd = sd(ic_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
    ic_uM_sd = sd(ic_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    ic_mgL = mean(ic_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
    ic_uM = mean(ic_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    YSI_Temp_C = mean(YSI_Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    YSI_Sal_ppt = mean(YSI_Sal_ppt, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Take the first value of all OTHER columns not mentioned above
    across(-c(ic_mgL, ic_mgL_sd, ic_uM, ic_uM_sd, YSI_Temp_C, YSI_Sal_ppt, Replicate), first),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  select(Project, Date, Time, Sample_Location, ic_mgL, ic_mgL_sd, ic_uM, ic_uM_sd, ic_flag) %>% 
  mutate(Date = if_else(Date == as.Date("2025-11-10"), as.Date("2025-10-11"), Date)) %>% ##Fix date entered incorrectly
  mutate(Time = if_else(Date == as.Date("2025-10-11") & Sample_Location == "Dock", "13:18", Time)) %>% ##Fix missing timestamps
  mutate(Time = if_else(Date == as.Date("2025-10-11") & Sample_Location == "Flume", "11:48", Time)) %>% ##Fix missing timestamps
  mutate(Time = if_else(Date == as.Date("2025-12-04") & Sample_Location == "Flume", "11:23", Time)) %>% ##Fix missing timestamps
  mutate(Time = if_else(Date == as.Date("2025-12-04") & Sample_Location == "Dock", "12:24", Time)) ##Fix missing timestamps

```

##Combine dataframes
```{r combine bottle data}

DIC_DOC <- merge(DIC_data1, DOC_data1, by = c("Project", "Date", "Time", "Sample_Location"), all = TRUE)
DIC_DOC <- DIC_DOC %>% 
  filter(Sample_Location != "Dock") %>% 
  rename(Time_Local = Time) %>% 
  mutate(lat = 38.874861, 
         long = -76.546472, 
         ic_uM = round(ic_uM, 2), 
         npoc_uM = round(npoc_uM, 2), 
         tdn_uM = round(tdn_uM, 2) )

```

##Merge with metadata
```{r metadata}
##Read in metadata files
meta_2025 <- read.csv("../../FATE Monitoring/Metadata/FATE_Monitoring_Metadata_2025.csv", colClasses = "character")
meta_2026 <- read.csv("../../FATE Monitoring/Metadata/FATE_Monitoring_Metadata_2026.csv", colClasses = "character")

meta <- bind_rows(meta_2025, meta_2026)

##Remove unnecessary metadata
meta1 <- meta %>% 
  mutate(Date = mdy(Date)) %>% 
  select(-c(DIC_24ml, DIC_ex_1ml, SO4.H2S_5ml, Nutr_10ml, DOC_20ml, TA_250ml))

##Merge with metadata
all_data <- DIC_DOC %>% 
  left_join(meta1, by = c("Date", "Time_Local", "Sample_Location"))

```

## Subset data and write out collated files
```{r, echo=FALSE}

##Select columns in order for final data output
final_data <- all_data %>% 
  rename_with(tolower, .cols = c(Project, Date, Time_Local, Sample_Location)) %>%
  
  ##Round data
  mutate(across(c(ic_mgL, ic_mgL_sd, ic_uM, ic_uM_sd, npoc_mgL, npoc_uM, tdn_mgL, tdn_uM), ~ round (as.numeric(.x), digits = 2))) %>% 

  ##ADL/BDL flags
  mutate(npoc_flag = case_when(
    npoc_flag == "blank is> 25% of sample value" | npoc_mgL < 0.5 ~ "bdl",  
    npoc_flag == "value above cal curve" ~ "adl", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  mutate(tdn_flag = case_when(
    tdn_flag == "blank is> 25% of sample value" | tdn_mgL < 0.25 ~ "bdl",
    tdn_flag == "value above cal curve" ~ "adl",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>%
  mutate(ic_flag = case_when(
    ic_flag == "blank is> 25% of sample value" | ic_mgL < 1 ~ "bdl",
    ic_flag == "value above cal curve" ~ "adl",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>%
  
  mutate(lat = 38.874861, 
         long = -76.546472) %>% 
  select(project, date, time_local, sample_location, lat, long, ic_mgL, ic_mgL_sd, ic_uM, ic_uM_sd, ic_flag, npoc_mgL, npoc_uM, npoc_flag, tdn_mgL, tdn_uM, tdn_flag)

final_data_2025 <- subset(final_data, year(date) == 2025)

##Write out annual data files
write.csv(final_data_2025, "FATE_Monitoring_DIC_DOC_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Data Description 
```{r data description}

#Create a text file that has the description of the data - This ideally should match the text that is in the data READ.ME 

datadescription <- "These data are measurements of dissolved inorganic carbon, dissolved organic carbon, and total dissolved nitrogen concentrations in samples collected from tidal creek surface waters as part of the FATE project conducted at the Smithsonian Environmental Research Center's Global Change Research Wetland (GCReW) in the Kirkpatrick Marsh along the Rhode River in Edgewater, MD, USA. Samples were collected roughly bi-weekly throughout 2025. Surface waters of the GCReW tidal creek were collected at the GCReW Flume (38.87486, -76.5465). Samples were collected with a bucket and filtered immediately with 0.45 um syringe filters into combusted glass vials and kept on ice during transport to fridge or freezer. Dissolved inorganic carbon samples were collected with no headspace in combusted 24mL vials with septa caps and refrigerated until analysis. Dissolved inorganic carbon concentrations were determined with a Shimadzu TOC using the manufacturers IC method within one week of collection with a bicarbonate and carbonate standard curve and certified seawater reference material (CRM) from the Scripps Institution of Oceanography of the University of California, San Diego. Dissolved organic carbon and total nitrogen samples were collected in combusted, amber 40mL vials and frozen until analysis. Concentrations of non-purgeable organic carbon and total nitrogen were determined with a Shimadzu TOC using the manufacturers NPOC/TN methodology with potassium hydrogen phthalate (KHP) and potassium nitrate standard curves."


#write to a text file 
writeLines(datadescription, "DataDescription.txt")


```

## Create Author List 
```{r create author list}

#Pull in the common synoptic authors list: 
authors_common <- read.csv(here("Figshare/", "SERC_LateralFlux_common_author_list.csv"))


#create a list of the last names you want to pull 
names_we_want <- c("Wilson", "Miller","Read", "Reynolds", "Tamborski", "Megonigal")
order_of_authors <- c(1:length(names_we_want))

authors <- data.frame(
  order_of_authors = unlist(order_of_authors), 
  last_name = unlist(names_we_want)
)

#Subset the common list for the names that we want 
author_list <- authors %>% 
  left_join(authors_common, by = "last_name")

#if you need to add any other authors 
others <- data.frame(
  first_name = c("first_name1", "first_name2"), 
  last_name = c("last_name1", "last_name2"), 
  orcid = c("orcid_id1", "orcid_id2"), 
  affiliation = c("affiliation1", "affiliation2"), 
  email = c("email1", "email2"), 
  order_of_authors = c((length(names_we_want)+1):(length(names_we_want)+2))
)

#add in the other authors 
#author_list <- bind_rows(author_list, others)

#write out the author list associated with the data:
write.csv(author_list, "AuthorList.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
